answer: A sponsor carries 29% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. Because the orchard liability is entered in the vine ledger at admission, the dawn audit shows the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A farm must hence place its own capital behind each duplicate self it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 31 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
